title: Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia, IBM, and others back open-weight AI
summary: Over two dozen major tech companies including Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia, IBM, and others have signed an open letter urging US policymakers to protect open-weight AI models, demonstrating unusual collaboration between direct commercial rivals on AI policy advocacy.
problem_solved: Addresses regulatory threats to open-weight AI models that could limit innovation and competition in the AI industry.
why_valuable: Unprecedented coalition of competitors united to shape AI policy demonstrates the critical importance of open-weight models for the future of AI development and accessibility.
